question: Is the canonical date range of the 1997 《北京图书馆馆史资料汇编（二）》 1946—1966 as printed in Cai/Li 2024 reference [23], or 1949—1966?
answer: The canonical 1997 bibliographic identity is 1949—1966. Google Books volume BZ0M0gEACAAJ identifies the 1997 Beijing Library Press volume as 《北京图书馆馆史资料汇编: 1949-1966》, Volume 2, ISBN 7501314195 / 9787501314195, 1811 pages. Independently, the National Library of China-hosted 《文津流觞》2023年第4期, in Ma Tao's article 《王重民与鼎新之际的国家图书馆》, visibly cites 《北京图书馆馆史资料汇编（二）（1949—1966）》, Beijing Library Press, 1997, p.606. Cai/Li 2024 reference [23] literally prints 1946—1966 for the same editor/publisher/year and pp.446—449; that literal source-layer variant is preserved but adjudicated as a high-confidence bibliographic typo rather than canonical title identity.
